title: BFS distances, connected components and the graph Laplacian
summary: Find shortest path lengths with a breadth-first search, label connected components, and build the graph Laplacian whose zero eigenvalues count the components.

mutants.stack_instead_of_queue: Takes nodes from the end of the queue, which is a depth-first order, and so can find paths that are too long.
mutants.source_distance_one: Gives the source a distance of 1 and not 0.
mutants.labels_never_increase: Does not move to the next label, so every component gets label 0.
mutants.labels_are_start_nodes: Labels each component with its first node and not with the next label in 0, 1, 2, ...
mutants.laplacian_negated: Computes A - D and not D - A.
